Generate a NEW high-resolution clean transparent sprite atlas of FOUR separate complete floor rugs for the approved PokeCorner room. Rectangular rugs have almost horizontal top/bottom edges, backedge modestly shorter than frontedge, sides slantout subtly, complete near frontedge and far backedge visible. Whole silhouette including fringes fitswithin cell. Ovalrug similarly flatelongated ellipse, neverdeepvertical. Transparent outside object, no roomfloor, no castshadow, no wall, no glow, no Pokemon character. Rug material/pattern fullyopaque. All4rugs share the warm oatmeal cream, soft muted honey shadows; companion checks and borders warm taupe palette. Top-right:checkeredrectangularrug, veryreadablelargechecks followingfloorplane, narrowwovenbindingedge, no emblem. Bottom-left:softovalrug, rounded complete plushoutline, subtle fleecytexture with smoothcenter, no checks/no motif. Bottom-right:borderedrectangularrug with a single understated mutedPokeball textilemotifnearcenter, restrained finegeometricborder, no checks, nofringe.
